# Faegre Drinker

> > Faegre Drinker's internal employee portal and human resources management system powered by Aderant viDesktop.

This site provides access to Faegre Drinker Biddle & Reath LLP's employee-facing tools and resources. The portal supports performance management, evaluations, and HR operations for the law firm's workforce.
